This is good for click&stick element pairs.  It raises or sinks elements by swaping their layers with the highest or lowest elements in the list.A list of registered elements is kept.The elements in the list are the parent elements of the element pairs.The assumption is that the child element is at a lower layer then the parent element.Each time a swap is to be done, the list is searched for the highest or lowest element.  This allows cloning which changes the element layers.
